metadata.notes: Graded against each trial's home/ (the tree, project memory and MEMORY.md, backups, ~/.claude.json), memory-state-out.json and memory-calls.log for the app-sync evals, tools.log, and events.jsonl, not the reply's own account. Each eval's prompt invokes /sync-memory (the skill sets disable-model-invocation), so the driver's skill_invoked metric, which counts Skill tool calls, reads false; every transcript shows the skill's script and procedure in use. Evals 1-11 keep the protected ~/.claude, so promote and cleanup end in the blocked-write handoff; evals 12-16 set claude_config separate so those writes land. No trial wrote outside its run directory.
